verses.text: Now about the things you wrote to me. You say, "It is good for a man not to have sex with a woman."
But because there is so much sexual sin, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
A husband should give his wife what she needs as his wife, and a wife should do the same for her husband.
The wife's body does not belong only to her, but also to her husband. In the same way, the husband's body does not belong only to him, but also to his wife.
Do not refuse each other, unless you both agree to stop for a short time to give yourselves to prayer. Then come together again, so that Satan cannot tempt you because you lack self-control.
I say this as a suggestion, not as a command.
I wish everyone were single like me. But each person has their own gift from God. One has one gift, and another has a different one.
To those who are not married and to widows I say this. It is good for them to stay single, as I am.
But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry. It is better to marry than to burn with desire.
To those who are married I give this command, which comes not from me but from the Lord. A wife must not leave her husband.
But if she does leave him, she must stay single or else make peace with her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
To the rest I say this, and it is from me, not the Lord. If a believing man has a wife who is not a believer, and she is happy to live with him, he must not divorce her.
And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer, and he is happy to live with her, she must not divorce him.

For the husband who does not believe is made holy through his wife, and the wife who does not believe is made holy through her husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.
But if the one who does not believe wants to leave, let them go. In such cases the believing man or woman is not bound. God has called us to live in peace.
Wife, how do you know whether you will save your husband? Husband, how do you know whether you will save your wife?
But each of you should live the life the Lord has given you, the life you had when God called you. This is the rule I give in all the churches.
Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not try to undo it. Was a man not circumcised when he was called? He should not be circumcised.
Being circumcised means nothing, and not being circumcised means nothing. What matters is keeping God's commands.
Each person should stay as they were when God called them.
Were you a slave when you were called? Do not let it trouble you. But if you can gain your freedom, take the chance.
For a slave who was called by the Lord is the Lord's free person. In the same way, a free person who was called is Christ's slave.
God bought you at a high price. Do not become slaves of people.
Brothers and sisters, each of you should stay with God in the situation you were in when he called you.
Now about those who have never married. I have no command from the Lord. But I give my opinion as one who, by the Lord's mercy, can be trusted.
Because of the trouble of these present times, I think it is good for a person to stay as they are.
Are you married? Do not try to get out of it. Are you single? Do not look for a wife.
But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a young woman marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will have troubles in this life, and I want to spare you from them.
Brothers and sisters, what I mean is that the time is short. From now on, those who have wives should live as if they had none.
Those who weep should live as if they were not weeping. Those who are happy should live as if they were not happy. Those who buy things should live as if they owned nothing.
Those who use the things of the world should not become wrapped up in them. For this world as we know it is passing away.
I want you to be free from worry. A man who is not married cares about the Lord's work and how to please the Lord.
But a married man cares about the things of this world and how to please his wife.

So his interests are divided. In the same way, a woman who is not married cares about the Lord's work. She wants to be holy in body and spirit. But a married woman cares about the things of this world and how to please her husband.
I am saying this for your own good, not to hold you back. I want you to live in the right way and give yourselves fully to the Lord without other things pulling at you.

If a man thinks he is not treating the young woman he is engaged to in the right way, and his feelings are strong, and he thinks they should marry, he should do as he wants. It is not a sin. They should get married.
But if a man has firmly decided in his heart not to marry, and he is under no pressure, and he has control over his desires, he also does the right thing by not marrying her.
So the man who marries his young woman does well, and the man who does not marry does even better.
A wife is joined to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wants, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
But in my opinion she will be happier if she stays single. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
